report_subtitle: Generated by ForZip — Forensic compression and verification tool
report_disclaimer_text:
This report was automatically generated by ForZip, a free and open-source
tool distributed under the Apache License 2.0. Results are provided
"AS IS", without warranties of any kind. It is the sole responsibility
of the operator to validate the suitability of this tool and its results
for forensic use in their jurisdiction. ForZip does not replace the
professional judgment of the examiner.
report_encryption_aes_7z: AES-256 of contents and file names (password applied)
error_no_algorithms: At least one hash algorithm must be selected.
error_security_software_blocked: This computer's security software blocked access to the evidence or package because it classified the content as a threat. ForZip does not scan or exclude files: it aborted rather than create an incomplete package. Use a forensic workstation or evidence path with a narrowly scoped institutional exclusion and try again.
error_security_blocked_read: This computer's antivirus or EDR blocked reading an evidence file: {0}. ForZip does not scan or exclude files, and no program can read what the system blocks. Packaging stopped and the partial package was removed.
error_security_blocked_write: This computer's antivirus or EDR blocked writing the package: {0}. Packaging stopped and the partial package was removed.
error_security_blocked_reread: The package was fully created at {0}, but this computer's antivirus or EDR blocked re-reading it to compute the global hash. The manifest was not generated.
error_security_blocked_quarantined: The package was created, but this computer's antivirus or EDR deleted or quarantined it: {0}. Check the computer's protection history.
error_security_blocked_seal: This computer's antivirus or EDR blocked sealing while accessing {0}. The package files remain on disk, unsealed.
report_completeness_incomplete: INCOMPLETE — {0} file(s) not included; see FILES NOT INCLUDED
reason_missing_at_packaging: present when selected, absent when packaging
reason_link_not_followed: link or junction inside the source, not followed
report_omitted_basis_unreadable:
Files marked as not read could not be opened or read while computing their
hash, for the reason given by each one's Windows code (for example,
ERROR_VIRUS_INFECTED when security software denies the read, or a file in use
or without permission). ForZip did not compute their hash: they are not in the
tables. The originals remain at the path shown, unmodified.
report_omitted_basis_link:
The items marked as links are symbolic links or junctions that were inside the
source and point somewhere else on the disk. ForZip does not follow them: what is
on the other side is not part of the selection, and following them could pull
files unrelated to the evidence into the package or run into a loop. The link is
recorded with its target; if that content is evidence, select it separately.
report_omitted_basis_blocked:
During packaging, Windows denied read access to the files marked as blocked
because this computer's security software (antivirus or EDR) classified them
as a threat, as shown by the Windows code given for each one. ForZip does not
scan content or decide exclusions: it could not read these files and
therefore neither included them in the package nor computed their hash.
Consequently, the package does not carry the files the security software
identified as a threat. The originals remain at the source path shown,
unmodified by ForZip, and can be acquired on a forensic workstation with a
controlled exclusion.
report_omitted_basis_missing:
The files marked as absent were at the source when the operator selected it
and were gone by packaging time, or disappeared while packaging. ForZip
neither deleted nor moved them, and could not read them: they are not in the
package and have no hash. One possible cause is that the security software
quarantined them, which happens, for example, when the Windows selection
dialog reads them to display them; another, that they were moved or deleted.
The computer's protection history and the source path shown should be
reviewed.
report_omitted_basis_common:
The omission is recorded so that the procedure is auditable and can be
examined and reproduced by an independent third party, in accordance with
principle 3 of the ACPO Good Practice Guide for Digital Evidence (v5, 2012),
the auditability and justifiability requirements of ISO/IEC 27037:2012, and
the documentation guidance of NIST SP 800-86 and RFC 3227.

This section does not certify that the rest of the package is free of
malicious software: security software only blocks what it recognizes.

settings_trust_desc: A signature proves that the manifest or receipt has not changed since it was signed, not who signed it: whoever creates a certificate chooses its name. What identifies a certificate is its SHA-256 fingerprint. Load here the fingerprint of each examiner or office you trust (ask for it through a secure channel, or read it from their .cer certificate): when verifying, ForZip will tell whether the signature is one of theirs.

settings_trust_bad_thumbprint: The fingerprint is not valid: it must be 64 hexadecimal characters (spaces and colons are accepted).
settings_trust_need_name: Type a name to recognise the signer.
settings_trust_duplicate: That fingerprint is already in the list.

shell_offer_title: Add ForZip to the context menu?
shell_offer_msg:
ForZip can integrate with the Windows Explorer context menu: Compress, Extract, Verify and Hash one click away.

Nothing is installed, no administrator rights are required, and you can remove it anytime from Settings → Integration.

update_confirm_msg: Version {0} ({1}) will be downloaded and its SHA-256 checksum verified before anything is installed.
update_confirm_steps: When it finishes, ForZip closes and reopens by itself. Save any work in progress before continuing. The previous executable is kept as a copy until the next startup, in case you need to roll back.
log_update_done: ForZip was updated from version {0} to {1}.
update_manual_note: Updating is never automatic: you ask for it. ForZip verifies the published SHA-256 checksum of the downloaded binary and installs nothing if it does not match. The previous executable is kept as a copy until the next startup, in case you need to roll back.
settings_check_updates_hint: Queries the ForZip releases page when the application opens. It is the only network connection ForZip initiates on its own, and it sends no data about the machine or the evidence. Disabled by default.
act_package_sha256:
SHA-256 of the envelope (write it down in the chain of custody record and
check it against the file received):
act_password_note:
The first line is the exact password. In the grouped version the spaces are
NOT part of the key: they are there only to make it easier to transcribe.
Without this password the content is unrecoverable: there is no key recovery
and no key escrow.
act_open_text:
The envelope comes with Open_FZS.html, a page that opens it with
nothing to install. Double-click it to open it in Microsoft Edge or Google
Chrome, choose the .fzs file, type the password written on this record and
choose where to save. The result is an ordinary ZIP file. The page works
offline and does not run the content.

To check that the page is the original one, its SHA-256 must be:

      {1}

On Windows: certutil -hashfile Open_FZS.html SHA256

The envelope can also be opened with ForZip, the same tool that sealed it
({0}): choose "Extract", select the .fzs file, type the password and
choose a destination folder that is not synced with the cloud. ForZip
opens the envelope and verifies its content against the manifest. The
text forensic report is then generated from "Verify", choosing the
manifest and "Save report…".

ForZip is free and open source (Apache 2.0). It can be downloaded, together
with its source code, from:

      https://github.com/patagoniarobot/forzip

Even without the password it can be checked that the envelope was not
altered: that is what the .receipt.json accompanying the package is for, and
it requires no key at all.

The envelope format is published in that same repository, along with a
standalone extractor written in Python, in case ForZip is no longer
available many years from now.
act_warning_title: WARNING — WHERE NOT TO OPEN THIS ENVELOPE
act_warning_text:
Do not open the envelope or extract its contents inside a folder synced with
Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox. The contents would be uploaded to the
cloud in the clear and automatically, file names and all, with nobody making
that decision and with no warning left behind.

identified on this record.

home_title: What do you need to do?

verify_subtitle: Choose a package, its manifest, a report or a .fzs envelope. ForZip compares every file with the fingerprint recorded when it was packaged.
verify_lead_valid: Everything matches the recorded fingerprint. Nothing changed.
verify_lead_invalid: Some files do not match their original fingerprint. Do not use this package as evidence without reviewing the details.

pwgen_subtitle: A strong password that is easy to dictate: no characters that can be confused with each other.
pwgen_excluded_hint: They are left out to avoid mistakes when copying or dictating the password.

report_from_manifest_note:
This report was generated from the package manifest. The evidence is the package with its
manifest, not this text. To check that the package did not change, compare its SHA-256
fingerprint with the one written down in the chain of custody record.
result_zip_hash_custody: Write this fingerprint down in the chain of custody record: it is what later proves the package did not change. The manifest alone is not enough, because whoever changes the package can change it too.
save_report_hint: The forensic report, to read, print or attach to the case file: as an HTML page that opens with a double click, or as text. It is optional: it can also be generated later from Verify.

hash_export_inside_source: Not saved: the report would end up inside what was hashed ({0}) and mix with the evidence. Choose a folder outside it.
report_folder_incomplete: No fingerprint: {0} file(s) inside could not be read.
report_folder_links: {0} link(s) not followed: they are not part of the fingerprint.
report_folder_note:
The ForZip fingerprint is the SHA-256 of the sorted list of files, each with its SHA-256 and its relative
path: it changes if a byte, a name or the location of a file changes. It can be recomputed without ForZip
with the procedure published in Huella_de_Carpeta_v1.md. The 7-Zip value is the "SHA256 for data" of
7z h -scrcSHA256: it can be checked with 7-Zip, but it does not depend on the names.
hash_folder_need_sha256: The folder fingerprint uses SHA-256: tick SHA-256 and calculate again.
hash_folder_incomplete: No fingerprint: {0} file(s) inside could not be read.
hash_folder_links: {0} link(s) not followed: they are not part of the fingerprint.
hash_folder_hint: The ForZip fingerprint changes if a byte, a name or the location of a file changes. The 7-Zip one can be checked with 7z h -scrcSHA256 and does not depend on the names.
verify_lead_valid_tested: Every file passed its own check. Without a manifest, that does not prove it is the original: write down its fingerprint.
verify_lead_invalid_tested: Some files do not pass their own check: they are damaged or were altered.
verify_lead_nochecks_tested: It was read in full, but this format carries no checks: an alteration cannot be detected.
verify_lead_unreadable_tested: The archive could not be tested: the details say why.
verify_test_sfx: Self-extracting: it was read as an archive, not run.
verify_test_skipped: {0} link(s), device(s) or NTFS stream(s) with no content to test.
verify_test_note: No manifest: this proves the archive is sound according to its own checks, not that it is the original. Write the SHA-256 fingerprint down in the chain of custody record.
verify_test_nochecks: TAR and ISO keep no checksum of their contents: it was checked that it reads in full, not that it has not changed.
verify_test_password_needed:
The archive is encrypted and no password was typed: nothing was tested.
Type the password in the password field and verify again.
verify_test_wrong_password_certain: The password is wrong: the archive keeps a password check value and it does not match. Nothing was tested.
verify_lead_wrong_password_tested: The password is wrong: nothing was tested.
verify_test_wrong_password: The password does not open the archive, or the first encrypted file is damaged: the two cannot be told apart.
verify_picker_archives: Archive without a manifest (ZIP, 7z, RAR, TAR, ISO, self-extracting .exe)
verify_running_test: Testing the archive: it is decompressed in memory, nothing is written…
log_hash_export_inside_source: Hash report export stopped: the chosen path is inside what was hashed.
report_html_note:
This document presents the data in the package manifest so it can be read and printed. It is neither signed
nor verified: the evidence is the package with its manifest and the package SHA-256 fingerprint written down
in the chain of custody record.
report_html_custody: Compare this fingerprint with the one written down in the chain of custody record: if they match, it is the same package.
picker_report_html: HTML page (opens with a double click)
